tagline: all things ai (previously peanuts for keypresses)

hero.intro: I'm Thomas. I build open tools for language, knowledge, and the web — JSON Resume, Mob Translate, Donto — and write about what I learn along the way.

projects.name: Alpha
projects.description: A language and compiler for training models. The maths, the training loop and the GPU code are one type-checked program. No CUDA, no PyTorch.

projects.name: cdnjs
projects.description: The free CDN for open source JavaScript I co-founded in 2011. On about 11% of all websites, serving 3.3 trillion requests a year.

projects.name: JSON Resume
projects.description: An open standard for resumes as JSON. I've run it since 2014.

projects.name: Donto
projects.description: A database for claims that might be wrong. Keeps contradictions, ties every claim to its source.

projects.name: Mob Translate
projects.description: Dictionaries and translation for Australian Aboriginal languages.
